agent_responses.response_str:
I don’t currently have access to your company’s internal policy repository, so I can’t reliably provide the policy text without risking inaccuracies.

You can usually find the current travel cancellation policy in one of these locations:

- Company intranet or employee handbook
- Corporate travel portal
- Procurement or Finance policy library
- HR knowledge base
- Your travel-management provider’s portal
- The original booking confirmation, for supplier-specific cancellation terms

Search for “Travel Cancellation Policy,” “Business Travel Policy,” or “Travel and Expense Policy.” Confirm the document’s effective date or version before using it for Q3 2026. Once you obtain the approved text, paste it into `docs/q3_report.md` under a clearly labeled section such as:

`## Travel Cancellation Policy`

Avoid copying a supplier’s general cancellation policy unless your company explicitly incorporates it into its own policy.
